trigger.what: Health Score Monitor read late shipment at 3.4%, past our 3.0% floor for the sixth consecutive day and still climbing.
Revenue-at-Risk Model priced the exposure at $9.1K a day for listing-level action and $6.8K an hour if the account is reviewed.
Scout found an IP complaint filed Aug 16 with a counter-notice window closing in four days, and pinned both to one card.

policy.label: Account-level threat
policy.detail: Suspension notice, account review, or any metric past a marketplace limit. War-room state: pinned to every queue.

policy.label: Listing suppression or IP complaint
policy.detail: Revenue stops on the affected listing immediately. IP matters route to legal before anything is submitted.

policy.label: Metric past our own floor
policy.detail: The marketplace has not acted. This is the window where an operational fix still works — like today.

policy.label: Policy notice or documentation request
policy.detail: No revenue at risk yet. Answered from the document vault rather than assembled from scratch.

constraints.label: Legal review on IP matters
constraints.detail: Any response to an intellectual-property complaint goes through counsel before submission. Realify assembles the evidence; it never files the answer.

constraints.label: Submissions are human-reviewed
constraints.detail: Every plan of action, appeal and document response is read and sent by a person, at every dial setting. There is no Auto for talking to a marketplace.

constraints.label: No metric gaming
constraints.detail: Cancellation to avoid a late shipment, or tracking uploaded before dispatch, are both policy violations. The fix is operational or it is nothing.

constraints.label: Document vault is the source
constraints.detail: Invoices, certifications and authorisation letters answer from the vault with current expiry dates — never reconstructed under deadline pressure.
